retrievalProfile.description: A centered dark silhouette against a bright, glowing background with a large, fluid script title overlaying the midsection.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a dark silhouette of a man reaching upward toward a blinding white light source, set against a pale teal-grey gradient with prominent script and block typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical alignment of the figure and light source
Horizontal script text intersecting the vertical silhouette
Top-left corner placement of secondary block text within a frame
High contrast between the dark figure and the radiant white glow
coreInvariants: The silhouette must remain solid black or near-black to maintain the high-contrast effect.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length silhouette centered vertically, occupying approximately 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intense white light orb at the top center, held by the silhouette's hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top light source, follows the silhouette down to the large script text, then moves to the top-left corner logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive pale teal-grey background providing a clean, minimalist feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between the light source and the subject.

letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with a large, stylized uppercase initial
Horizontal orientation with a slight upward tilt
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'I' is oversized and serves as a visual anchor for the left side of the text block.

composition.relationshipToImage: enclosed in a thin rectangular frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, organic script and rigid, geometric block sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Rectangular border framing the top-left text
Subtle radial gradient for the light source

preserve: The teal-grey color of the text
The intersection of the script with the silhouette

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the main title.
Approximates the heavy, blocky feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-length silhouette of a man in dark clothing reaching his hands upward to hold a glowing white orb of light. The background is a pale teal-grey with a subtle radial gradient emanating from the light source.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold teal-grey script word across the center of the image, overlapping the silhouette. In the top-left corner, add two lines of heavy, uppercase block text enclosed in a thin teal-grey rectangular frame.

verificationChecks: Is the light source at the top center radiant and white?
Does the script text overlap the figure?
Is the top-left text framed in a box?

mustRedesign: Exact handwriting patterns of the original script

avoid: Jagged or pixelated edges on the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the light flare.
Ensure the script text is legible against the dark silhouette.
Verify the vertical alignment of the figure and light.
Confirm the color palette is strictly limited to teal, black, and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette + Radiant Light Source + Overlapping Script + Framed Corner Text
